findings.text: Widget.js `load_earlier()` already sets `this.waiting = rest.slice(0, from)` before the draw loop, so `hold_orphan()` does not re-hold the entries it replays through `this.draw(l)`; correct, but only because of that line order. A one-line comment there would protect it.

`hold_orphan()` also holds a placement whose sentence sits in a chunk older than the one being loaded; it stays in `this.orphans` until that chunk loads, which is the right behaviour. `test/earlier.mjs` only proves the one-click case (sentence 3 of 70), not a two-step hold.

The `[data-thread-state]` description in `doc/widget-notes.md#thread-state` (not in the diff) does not list the new `this.orphans` map, though `reset()` clears it. Add it there so the thread's state is documented in one place.

The task folder holds only requirements.md and the diff; the test's JSON output (the `cards` and `fail` fields) is not saved, so a fresh agent has to re-run `ux/Dictate/test/earlier.mjs` to see the proof.

answer.reply: fixed: comment on the waiting line in load_earlier().
noted: a two-step hold stays in orphans until its chunk loads; the one-click fixture is the case seen live.
declined: widget-notes.md has no thread-state section listing summaries or settled either; the state is documented beside the code (Widget.js constructor) and in voice-assistant.md#nothing-jumps.
